about: Authored frozen-art integration review record (reviewer decisions; spoiler-safe: ids, screen keys and generic descriptions only). tools/art-integration.mjs combines it with the live runtime to generate docs/art_integration/INTEGRATION_MATRIX.json. Statuses that the runtime can prove (integrated, placeholder, no art) are derived, never authored here.

bruce_loose.bow.note: No scene narrates a bow; the lesson beat could carry it but the content does not say so. Needs a Story/HQ call before wiring.

deacon_brass.blessing.note: Armory beats mention grace but never narrate a blessing gesture.

hilt.walk_away.note: A23 'leave' narrates Hilt leaving, but Hilt is never on stage in that adventure (entrance line only); wiring it would add a cast member to the beat.

iron_jaw.rapping.note: The battle itself is the BARS minigame (UI overlay); no adventure beat shows him mid-verse.

rich.fishing_cast.note: The cast happens inside the PIER minigame; the repeat PIER adventure referenced by places/temptations is not defined in content.

tunde.asleep_floor.note: No current OPEN beat stages Tunde on the floor.

dre.asleep_floor.note: No current OPEN beat stages Dre on the floor.

assets/before_the_fame/props/agege_bread.note: No runtime visual surface yet: the bread appears only as text (HATCH food labels, items); wiring it needs a UI design decision, not a guess.

assets/before_the_fame/ui/apps/app_picku.note: No PICKUP phone app exists at runtime (PICKUP is a minigame), and the icon's imagery does not obviously match that minigame. Needs an HQ call on which surface it belongs to.

assets/before_the_fame/ui/apps/app_jdmim.note: Wired to the JDMIMPORTS app per the frozen asset id and HQ decision; CURRENT_OPEN_ART_GAPS prose names it RICHBOIIMPORTS — flagged for HQ confirmation.
